svg.title: Complete Power Tree Architecture
svg.desc: Hierarchical power distribution from 200mAh LiPo battery through LDO/PMIC to system subsystems, showing voltage levels, current consumption, and decoupling strategies

g.text: ESR: 50mΩ | BMS: Over-discharge protection @ 2.8V | Iq drain: 5 µA

svg.text: Recommended: Option B for production (saves 13 µA, better thermal)

g.text: Bulk Capacitance: 80–100 µF | ESR: <50 mΩ | Ripple target: <100 mVpp
Via stitching: Every 2–3mm | GND plane: >99% coverage (Layer 2) | RF isolated supply (VDDRF on Layer 3)

svg.text: Decoupling: 47µF LDO output + 10µF per subsystem + 1µF ferrite-core distributed

g.text: Identified Leakage Paths: I2C pull-ups 330µA (GATE!) | LDO Iq 15µA | BMI270 50µA (cannot avoid) | BMS 5µA | Misc 10µA = 410µA total unmitigated
